name: The Long Rains
source:
Over a thousand years ago, art, poetry and literature were at their height in the golden age of Japanese culture.
As a young woman starting out in life, your choices can make your reputation- or ruin it! 

Set in the world of the Heian-era webcomic Beneath The Clouds.

[Based on [url=https://carolinebtclouds.itch.io/the-long-rains]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一千多年前，正值日本文化的黄金时代，艺术、诗歌与文学都达到了鼎盛。
作为一名初涉世事的年轻女子，你的选择既能为你赢得美名，也可能让你名誉尽毁！

故事沿用以平安时代为背景的网络漫画《Beneath The Clouds》的世界观。

[根据[url=https://carolinebtclouds.itch.io/the-long-rains]Itch.io[/url]整理]
